figurative_meaning_en: quarrel over trivial or insignificant matters
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুই ভাই ফুটো পয়সার লড়াই করে সম্পত্তির জন্য ঝগড়া করছে।
অফিসে সবাই ফুটো পয়সার লড়াই করে সময় নষ্ট করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The two brothers are having a fight over holey coins regarding the property.
Everyone in the office is wasting time on a fight over holey coins.
history: Refers to old, worthless perforated coins used in historical Bengali currency, symbolizing futile disputes over valueless items.
note: The idiom highlights the futility of arguments over minor issues, common in Bengali oral tradition.
